title_zh: 限定下一次原型展示的演示范围

scenario.label_zh: 限定下一次原型展示的演示范围
scenario.goal_zh: 核对展示中已经可用的功能并约定只展示已可用部分并注明限制

context_zh: 虚构软件团队排练原型展示，只讨论沟通内容，不操作真实系统或发布服务。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Are we still planning to unveil the prototype at the upcoming team meeting?

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Yes, but only the navigation works. The export feature isn't ready.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: After the tremendous amount of work you've put in, I'd hate to hide what does work.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: We don't need to hide it. We just need to be clear about the limits.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Then I'll demonstrate the navigation and put the unfinished features on a separate slide.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: That works. Please call it a prototype throughout, not the finished product.
